techniques.label: Goal setting (behavior)
techniques.definition: Set or agree on a goal defined in terms of the behaviour to be performed.

techniques.label: Problem solving
techniques.definition: Analyse factors influencing behaviour and identify strategies to overcome barriers or increase facilitators.

techniques.label: Action planning
techniques.definition: Prompt detailed planning of the behaviour, including its context, frequency, duration or intensity.

techniques.label: Review behavior goal(s)
techniques.definition: Review behaviour goals and consider modifying them or the behaviour-change strategy based on achievement.

techniques.label: Feedback on behaviour
techniques.definition: Monitor and provide informative or evaluative feedback on behaviour performance.

techniques.label: Self-monitoring of behaviour
techniques.definition: Establish a method for the person to monitor and record their behaviour as part of a behaviour-change strategy.

techniques.label: Instruction on how to perform a behavior
techniques.definition: Advise or agree on how to perform the target behaviour.

techniques.label: Information about health consequences
techniques.definition: Provide information about the health consequences of performing the behaviour.

techniques.label: Prompts/cues
techniques.definition: Introduce or define an environmental or social stimulus intended to prompt the behaviour.

techniques.label: Behavioral practice/rehearsal
techniques.definition: Prompt practice or rehearsal of the behaviour to develop habit or skill.

techniques.label: Behavior substitution
techniques.definition: Prompt substitution of an unwanted behaviour with a wanted or neutral behaviour.

techniques.label: Habit formation
techniques.definition: Prompt repetition of a behaviour in the same context so that the context increasingly triggers the behaviour.

techniques.label: Graded tasks
techniques.definition: Set easy-to-perform tasks that become increasingly difficult but remain achievable.

techniques.label: Reduce negative emotions
techniques.definition: Advise on ways of reducing negative emotions to facilitate the target behaviour.

techniques.label: Restructuring the physical environment
techniques.definition: Change or advise changes to the physical environment to facilitate wanted behaviour or create barriers to unwanted behaviour.

techniques.label: Avoidance/reducing exposure to cues for the behavior
techniques.definition: Advise on avoiding exposure to specific social, contextual or physical cues associated with the behaviour.

techniques.label: Focus on past success
techniques.definition: Advise or prompt the person to focus on previous successes in performing the behaviour.
